risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent regarding revenue, margins, backlog, orders, losses, and restructuring, but contains standard forward-looking caveats and qualitative explanations around project timing, cyclicality, and tax judgments. Risk remains elevated due to cyclical end markets, prior backlog and revenue declines, continued net losses, customer project delays or cancellations, and reliance on estimates under percentage-of-completion accounting.
